def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = torch.minimum(t2, t0)
    idx2 = torch.tensor([4], device=t0.device)
    t0.scatter_add_(0, (t2.abs() % 24).long(), t2)
    t0[v1 > -1] = -4
    v1[t0 > -1] = 1
    idx3 = torch.tensor([0], device=t1.device)
    t1.index_fill_(1, idx3, -2)
    v4 = t1.unsqueeze(1)
    return (v4, t0, v1, t1, lst, dct)
